verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own receipt upload with automatic matching to existing expenses (an "upload receipt and match automatically" endpoint using a pre-signed S3 URL). Its AI assistants are also claimed to fetch receipts for employees, so the core of filing a receipt against the right transaction is evidenced. However, that matching is documented only as an API flow, not as an employee capture experience. Missing for 10: employee-facing photo capture in the mobile app, email-forwarding receipt intake, explicit OCR/data extraction of receipt fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
